extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: COHORTS.md suspects florio_2020 belongs to the mgh_lung_rescue cluster with fumagalli_2019. Checks run: (1) Registration — this report states no trial registration and is a retrospective cohort (IRB MGH-IRB-2017P000544); Fumagalli is NCT02503241 per COHORTS.md. (2) Enrolment windows overlap: this study's lung rescue team cohort enrolled 2015–2017 at MGH, and Fumagalli enrolled April 2016 to July 2017 at MGH. (3) Eligibility: both require ARDS and obesity-related physiology; however this paper states 'None of these patients participated in any MGH ARDS ongoing interventional trials', which may exclude the Fumagalli physiologic protocol patients if that study was interventional. Overlap could not be conclusively confirmed or refuted from the full text alone; left cohort_id null pending adjudication and contact with authors if needed.
unclear_items: extraction_flags.cohort_id / overlapping_cohort_with: possible overlap with fumagalli_2019 (mgh_lung_rescue cluster) not conclusively resolvable from the text; see overlap_evidence.

extraction_flags.general_notes: Supplementary material (Additional file 1: Tables S1–S4) referenced for baseline lung mechanics, cause of death detail, and the adjusted mortality model, but not provided with this PDF. The lung rescue team intervention is a bundle (esophageal manometry + LRM + decremental PEEP trial + EIT + TTE); esophageal manometry is one component, so the isolated effect of balloon-guided PEEP titration cannot be separated from the team approach. Abstract reports 28-day mortality as 31% vs 16% with HR 0.32 (0.13–0.78) and P = 0.012, whereas Table 3 reports 22/70 (31%) vs 8/50 (16%), P = 0.001, HR 0.31 (0.13–0.78); Table 3 values recorded here and the discrepancy flagged.
